verdict.rationale: Flagright's homepage markets built-in "explainable AI agents" for AML operations and "AI-native workflows" in case management, which implies tasks can be handed to an in-product AI. The evidence is only one-line marketing claims, and the docs MCP server is a client-side integration for external AI tools, not an in-product assistant. missing for 10: documentation of what tasks the AI agents perform, how users delegate or invoke them, scope and controls, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI Agents - Supercharge AML operations with explainable AI agents.
